_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: In a conversation started with -no-tools, auto compaction is off until turned on. Call "tool overrides" returns the tool overrides in the conversation's options as JSON ({} when unset). The screen is a 1280x800 desktop window. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match, "whose name contains X" a substring one. "The panel" is ".model-picker-panel". To "open the knob": click ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label"; the panel should be visible. To "edit tools": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the panel's data-testid "model-picker-tools"; the panel should be hidden. "The pills" are data-testid "model-picker-profiles"; "the profile X" is the radio (role "radio") named X inside them. To "edit profiles": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the pills. "The section" is data-testid "model-picker-auto-compaction"; "the section's X" is the radio named X inside it, and "the nudge" is its select (role "combobox"). "The dialog" is the element with role "dialog". "The X tool" is the dialog's radiogroup with aria-label X ('[role=radiogroup][aria-label="X"]'). "The auto compaction row" is the dialog's data-testid "auto-compaction". To "apply": click the dialog's button whose name contains "Apply to this conversation"; the dialog should be hidden. "The markers" are the data-testid "message-modelchange" elements. "Changed" is the panel's data-testid "model-picker-profile-changed". To "save as new" a name N: click changed's button whose name contains "Save as new…", fill changed's textbox named "New profile name" with N and press Enter in it. A "row" X is the dialog's data-testid "profile-row" containing the text X. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and open the knob. 2. The section's "Off" (in its radiogroup named "Auto compaction") should have aria-checked="true". 3. Edit tools. The auto compaction row's radio whose name contains "Off" should have aria-checked="true", and the browser tool's radio whose name contains "Default (off)" should have aria-checked="true". 4. Click the auto compaction row's radio whose name contains "On", then apply. 5. Call "tool overrides": it must return {"compact_in_place":"on"}.
